items.title: Visa adds Monad to stablecoin settlement options
items.summary: Scott Melker discusses Visa (V) adding Monad as yet another option for settlecoin settlements. Visa already allows settlements on ethereum (ETH-USD), Solana (SOL-USD), and Avalanche (AVAX-USD). "The Daily Wolf with Scott Melker" airs every day at 12:00 p.m. Tune in for your daily dose of all things crypto.
